dsp GenOrganBassPercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.707107 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6833

organBassPercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganBassPercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.707107 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6832

dsp GenFoldSinePluck2Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := sinpi(ph * 2.0)
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 2.0 + 1.0) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7411

dsp GenFoldSineSwell2Even where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.3 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := sinpi(ph * 2.0)
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 2.0 + 1.0) * envA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7161

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.3 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set ienv := ienvA

    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 4.0 + 2.0) * envA

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate

dsp GenFoldSineSwell7Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.3 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := sinpi(ph * 2.0)
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 7.0 + 3.5) * envA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.6893

dsp GenFoldSineGong7Even where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.8 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := sinpi(ph * 2.0)
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 7.0 + 3.5) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.6846

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

    set previous := gate

foldSineBass7Odd.source:
dsp GenFoldSineBass7Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 0.5 / sr))
    let base := sinpi(ph * 2.0)
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 7.0 + 3.5) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7062

dsp GenFoldTriSwell2Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.3 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := (1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0))
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 2.0 + 1.0) * envA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7333

dsp GenFoldTriSwell4Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.3 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := (1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0))
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 4.0 + 2.0) * envA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7413

dsp GenFoldTriGong2Even where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.8 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := (1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0))
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 2.0 + 1.0) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7782
